questions.question: Princess Leonor is the heir of her father, King Felipe VI. What does that mean?
questions.answer: She will be queen one day
wrong_answers: She lives alone in a castle
hints: It's about what will happen in the future.
It's what her father was before 2014.
One day she'll get to wear the crown.
questions.fun_fact: If she takes the throne, Leonor will be Spain's first queen in her own right since Isabella II, in the 19th century.

questions.description: Two cities that spend the whole year on vacation across the Strait.
questions.question: In 1995, Ceuta and Melilla passed their statutes and became… what?
hints: They aren't quite autonomous communities.
They're the only two of their kind in Spain.
Their name puts “city” together with the word used for Spain's self-governing communities.
questions.fun_fact: Until 1995, Ceuta was part of the province of Cádiz and Melilla part of the province of Málaga.

questions.description: Even the boss of the sky needs to come home at night.
questions.question: Look at this golden eagle. Where does it usually build its nest in Spain?
questions.answer: On a rocky cliff in the mountains
wrong_answers: In a hole in the ground
In the sand of a beach
On the roof of a house
hints: It likes to have a good view.
It's very high up and far from people.
Think of the crags of the Pyrenees.
questions.fun_fact: A golden eagle's nest can be more than 2 m (6.5 ft) wide, because the pair makes it bigger year after year.

questions.description: The little piggy that ran off to the hills and never went back on a diet.
questions.question: Roughly how much can a big male wild boar from Spain's hills weigh?
hints: It weighs much more than a big dog.
But much less than a cow.
It can weigh more than an adult man.
questions.fun_fact: Wild boar piglets are born with stripes on their backs, which is why in many parts of Spain they're called «rayones» (“stripies”).
